metadata.case_name: CHAN LUNG HING v. NG KAM MAN

plaintiff.occupation_after: Garage owner performing only light duties (general check ups, changing lubricants and simple tasks)

source: the injuries suffered by the plaintiff is soft tissue injury to neck and back
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon at neck level

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to back (lumbar) with tenderness over L1 to L3 and right paraspinal muscles
source: the injuries suffered by the plaintiff is soft tissue injury to neck and back
tenderness over L1 to L3 and right paraspinal muscles.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

manifestations.description: Intermittent attacks of right side neck pain, occurred 1-2 times a week aggravated by prolonged walking or sitting for over 1 hour, heavy delivery at work over 100 lbs.
Range of movement of his neck was reduced to half.
Diffuse tenderness over posterior neck and back.
Intermittent attacks of pain and tiredness of lower neck especially on exertion, or jogging with repeated movement for over 15 minutes or climbing underneath the car for inspection.
Tenderness over L1 to L3 and right paraspinal muscles; pain on flexion and left lateral flexion on extreme range.
Decreased lifting and carrying strength and tolerance and decreased walking tolerance.
Subjective complaint of about 30% decrease in sensation to touch of right whole upper limb.
Waddell’s test suggests symptoms magnification during the examination.

treatments_received: occupational therapy (22 sessions up to 30 March 2010)
private chiropractor treatments (23 October 2009 to 16 December 2010)
